_how_to_use: Fill this in for one semester, then press 'Load file' on the site and pick it.
The whole tab named by 'term' is replaced by what is in 'events'.
range.from must be a SUNDAY and range.to a SATURDAY, so the week columns line up.
One file per semester. Save it as e.g. 2025-26-sem1.json

_field_notes.id: any short unique code inside this semester, e.g. e001
_field_notes.start / end: YYYY-MM-DD. Same value on both for a one-day event.
_field_notes.span: number of days the block covers on the grid, 1 for a single day
_field_notes.category: workshop | lecture | webinar | vac | assessment | academic | holiday | observance
_field_notes.kind: the words shown above the title on the card, e.g. Guest Lecture
_field_notes.title: the event name
_field_notes.audience: list of classes, e.g. ["II MCA"] or [] if it applies to everyone
_field_notes._proof_box: Only workshop, lecture, webinar and vac get a proof tracker. Holidays and assessments do not, since they need no evidence.

events.title: Replace this with the actual lecture topic
A three-day workshop spans three columns on the grid
